def wrap(text, width):
    if width < 1:
        raise ValueError("width must be at least 1")
    
    words = text.split()
    if not words:
        return []
    
    lines = []
    current_line = ""
    
    for word in words:
        # Handle words longer than width by cutting them into pieces
        while len(word) > width:
            piece = word[:width]
            word = word[width:]
            
            # Place the piece as a word
            if not current_line:
                current_line = piece
            elif len(current_line) + 1 + len(piece) <= width:
                current_line += " " + piece
            else:
                lines.append(current_line)
                current_line = piece
        
        # Now word is <= width (or empty if it was exactly divisible)
        if not word:
            continue
            
        if not current_line:
            current_line = word
        elif len(current_line) + 1 + len(word) <= width:
            current_line += " " + word
        else:
            lines.append(current_line)
            current_line = word
    
    if current_line:
        lines.append(current_line)
    
    return lines
